text:
marta: anyone else seeing ap-northeast prometheus remote write ack lag? started ~11:07 UTC, p95 -> ~3s, queues growing :thinking:
kevin: yep, scrape durations up and a bunch of 503s from the proxy. looks like connection churn to peer endpoints
ryan: autoscaler replaced a couple GPU nodes in that AZ around 11:05, pods bounced. could be fanout amplification while endpoints flap
infra-bot: deploy-notice: canary relabel PR #482 merged at 10:58 — dropped `pod_template_hash` from exporter labels
marta: that relabel was meant to reduce cardinality, but could it interact with routing? note we also lowered remote_write timeout to 10s last week
kevin: proxy logs show `http2: stream reset` and `connection closed` then backlog in prometheus queue. sample rate steady, but queue_space_high metric spiking
ryan: logs snippet:
```
level=error msg=\"failed to send batch\" err=\"write tcp 10.2.3.4:443: connection reset by peer\"
```
also seeing `enqueue failed: queue full` in prometheus exporter metrics
marta: short mitigation plan — increase `remote_write.queue_capacity` and lower `max_samples_per_send` to reduce amplification. consider reverting the relabel canary if it correlates
kevin: +1 to revert canary quickly. i'll roll back the relabel change in the canary pool in 5m and scale proxy replicas +2 to help absorb bursts
ryan: i'll open an iptables/nat timeout tweak on the node bootstrap so ephemeral ports don't recycle too fast while we investigate. pinging network team @oncall-sre
oncall-sre: on it — network confirmed transient NAT port pressure in that subnet ~11:04-11:12. they bumped ephemeral port range and tuned connection tracking timeouts
marta: good. i'll make a follow-up ticket with perf graphs (p95/p99 ack latency, queue length), config diffs, and list of hypotheses. assign to eng-sre + infra
kevin: added a Grafana panel for `remote_write_ack_time` + `prometheus_queue_length`, adjusted alerting to avoid noisy pagers while we stabilize
marta: rollback completed, ack latency trending back toward baseline. keeping thread open until postmortem and config bake are done :+1:
